title: Student Records Manager
objective: Develop a database-backed application for managing synthetic student records.
skills: Classic ASP/VBScript page construction and IIS runtime awareness
Validation, output encoding, and appropriate authorization
Reproducible testing, dependency documentation, and safe failure handling

milestones.title: Requirements and data model
acceptance_criteria: State the use cases, data fields, request routes, and authorization rules.
Identify runtime/provider assumptions and sensitive-data boundaries.

milestones.title: Build the minimal vertical slice
acceptance_criteria: Implement one complete happy path using synthetic data.
Keep shared includes, configuration, persistence, and presentation responsibilities clear.

milestones.title: Validation, security, and failure cases
acceptance_criteria: Test a normal case, an invalid/boundary case, and a dependency failure.
Apply server-side authorization, safe output encoding, and parameterized SQL where relevant.

milestones.title: Verification and handoff
acceptance_criteria: Provide a test matrix, observed results, version/dependency notes, and reset/rollback steps.
List untested items without claiming deployment or production verification.

required_features: Add normal, failure, and boundary tests
Use synthetic data and keep protected details out of logs/responses
stretch_features: Add a repeatable regression checklist and a dependency inventory.
Add an explicit recovery or rollback plan.
Document candidate incremental-modernization boundaries where relevant.
test_plan: Test the normal flow with synthetic data.
Test a missing, malformed, or boundary value.
Test authorization and output handling wherever relevant.
Test one provider/COM/network failure in a local controlled environment when applicable.
Record the runtime/provider versions and reset/rollback procedure.

rubric.criterion: Testing evidence, documentation, and recovery plan

review_method: Human review of the project artifact, acceptance criteria, test evidence, security, runtime compatibility, resource cleanup, and documentation. No general-purpose ASP execution runner is assumed.
status_note: Project brief follows the attached PDF Section D; starter files are included, but runtime behavior and provider-specific details require local review.
